goal: Decide the next state of the Atlas Explorer Dynamics view from the button pressed, so a walk through the E8 reflection orbit is replayable control by control.

app.name: atlas-explorer-walk
app.title: Atlas walk controls
app.purpose: Decide where the Atlas instance stands after a Dynamics control event: at A0, away from it, in a random walk, or walking home.

fields.name: state
fields.means: where the instance stands now: A0, another instance, a running random walk, or a running walk home

fields.name: event
fields.means: the control used, or the end of a running word

fields.name: orbit
fields.means: whether the census of all 75,600 instances has finished

fields.name: lands
fields.means: whether the instance the event ends on is A0

meanings.home: the instance is A0, the canonical 48 classes
meanings.away: the instance is another of the 75,600 in the orbit
meanings.walking: a random word of 12 simple reflections is running and the controls are disabled
meanings.returning: the path back to A0 from the orbit map is running and the controls are disabled

rules.why: index.html runWord done: the walk ends at A0 when live.isA0
index.html runWord done: the walk ends at another instance
index.html setBusy: walk, reset and the simple reflection buttons are disabled while busy
index.html homeBtn: the pathToRoot word ends with the 48 classes A0 again
index.html setBusy: the controls stay disabled while the walk home runs
index.html walkBtn: runWord with 12 random simple reflections
index.html resetBtn: loc is restored to the identity, which is A0
index.html applyReflection: a reflection can carry the 48 classes back onto A0
index.html applyReflection: a simple reflection carries the Atlas to another instance
index.html: homeBtn is enabled only when orbit.done and the instance is not A0
index.html: walk home is disabled until the orbit is mapped, and finish does nothing when no word runs

app.otherwiseWhy: at A0, walk home is disabled and finish does nothing, so the instance stays home

properties.why: index.html: homeBtn is disabled when live.isA0
index.html: walk home needs the orbit map to find the path to A0
index.html setBusy: reflections are disabled during a walk
reset always restores A0 when it is enabled
the walk home always ends at A0

stakeholders.name: Visitor
stakeholders.text: Explores the E8 reflection orbit of the Atlas and needs every control to do what it says, and nothing while a walk runs.

stakeholders.name: Mathematician
stakeholders.text: Checks that the walk home always returns the 48 classes to A0 and that block reorderings are gauge transformations.

components.name: UOR Atlas Explorer page
components.text: The single-page explorer on GitHub Pages that draws the 120 classes and runs the reflection walks.

threats.name: Walk home without a map
threats.text: Walk home is pressed before the orbit census finishes, so there is no path to A0.

control.name: Map before home
control.text: Walk home leaves away only once the orbit is mapped.

threats.name: Overlapping words
threats.text: A control starts a second reflection word while one runs, so the instance shown is not the one the word reaches.

control.name: Busy lock
control.text: While a word runs, every control leaves the state as it is.

threats.name: Plane click during a walk
threats.text: A click on the plane in Dynamics mode applies a reflection without checking busy.
threats.accepted: The machine models the Dynamics buttons that setBusy disables; the plane click handler in index.html is not gated by busy and is outside this model.

quality.text: No button press changes the state while a walk or a walk home runs.
quality.measureText: Requests in walking or returning, other than finish, that answer a different state.

quality.text: Each of the four states is reachable from home.
quality.measureText: States no sequence of events reaches from the initial state.
